2126259048072839482.en_summary: What makes November scary is that rates don't explain it. The 10-year TIPS yield was 2.95% on 5 October with gold at $4,157, and 2.79% on 24 November with gold at $3,562. Real yields are lower and gold is down.
2126259048072839482.zh_summary: 十一月令人恐懼的是利率無法解釋它。10 年期 TIPS 收益率在 10 月 5 日為 2.95%，黃金在 4,157 美元，而 11 月 24 日為 2.79%，黃金在 3,562 美元。實際收益率更低，黃金卻下跌。

2126258178627187039.en_summary: I dunno. Sorta feel like there is a pattern here. But maybe next year will be the one, hey...?
2126258178627187039.zh_summary: 我不知道。感覺這裡有個模式。但也許明年會是那一年，嗩……？

2126254616014922232.en_summary: Experts comment on these things later, visionaries who read life warn of risks in advance. What's our secret? There is nothing new under the sun.
2126254616014922232.zh_summary: 專家事後評論這些事，有遠見、讀懂生活的人會提前預警風險。我們的秘密是什麼？太陽底下沒有新鮮事。

2126250002703888420.en_summary: This month's drop in gold below 4,000 has been driven by a "fear factor" (pink) loosely linked to the Fed and its hiking campaign. That "fear factor" is fading, a sign the Fed is fading as a downside driver.
2126250002703888420.zh_summary: 本月黃金跌破 4,000 是由與聯準會及其加息運動鬆散相關的「恐懼因素」（粉色）驅動的。該「恐懼因素」正在消退，表明聯準會作為下行驅動因素正在減弱。
